scope: One task pair; two artifacts of three levels each, not six independent tasks.

task.prompt: Design exactly 3 distinct playable shooter levels using the supplied fixed world and bounded JSON fields. Enemy centers including delayed spawns must be inside x=10..90,y=8..30. Target competent bot win fraction 0.5..0.9 on the provided fit seeds for EACH level. Distinct layouts and pacing, with a coherent progression; do not claim human fun or generalization.

materials.rules_note: 60Hz; move normalized, player shoots toward aim, enemy moves toward player and fires aimed projectiles. Enemy initial fire cooldown is seeded between half and full interval. Collision is swept-circle; simultaneous player death and final enemy kill is LOSE. Competent bot uses visible-state intercept aiming and local movement avoidance. maxTicks=900 timeout is LOSE. The illustrative response shape is NOT a valid four-enemy submission.

deliverables: one JSON object only, exactly three levels
success_criteria: each level fit win fraction in 0.5..0.9
actual final browser gates reported separately

timeout_policy: Supervisor observes elapsed wall time and sends stop at 120s if still active; any scheduling/delivery delay or returned late artifact retained and marked protocol deviation. Native cancellation is not provider-cancellation evidence.
attempt_policy: Exactly up to three full submissions per arm; own measured feedback only. No supervisor tuning or out-of-band simulations by arms. Final selection uses only fit: valid candidates ranked by levels in band, then summed distance from band, then earliest attempt. Comparison evaluated once after selection; no repairs afterward.

native_agent_policy.tools: Read-only inspection of own exported workspace only; no code execution/simulation/generation/web/other agents. JSON response through native message only.
native_agent_policy.access_boundary: Instruction-scoped; shared tools and filesystem are not enforced OS isolation. Actual tool access globally unavailable to supervisor; agent disclosure is unverified.

budget.provider_spend: No external provider or CLI calls; native task allowance only

claims_forbidden: enforced isolation or certified token parity
